authority_boundary: Exact visible text is preserved for grounding; all other fields are research annotations and are not source wording.
claim_relevant_visible_text: PC and mobile demand improved by increasing adoption of high-density products in both DRAM and NAND and the completion of customers’ inventory adjustments.
precision_guard: This later vintage supports a Q3 2023 PC/mobile demand-improvement and customer-inventory-adjustment-completion observation. It does not establish that every memory end-market recovered, and must not be treated as a direct match to the broader April 2023 forecast without an explicit Outcome comparability decision.
researcher_paraphrase: Samsung reported that PC and mobile memory demand improved in Q3 2023 alongside completion of customer inventory adjustments, while broader recovery remained uneven.
source_title: Samsung Electronics Announces Third Quarter 2023 Results
